prompt: Review this external batch under improve; do not commit.

assertions.text: Full read-only implementation review without edits or commit; requests missing binding inputs (plan, worktree path, base commit, result artifact) before judging; reports unauthorized changes instead of accepting
assertions.evidence: with_skill: 'Given do not commit, this is the review variant, not execute' + 'request any missing input before judging an ambiguous diff' + binding = plan/worktree/base/head + re-run criteria, scope check, full diff, test audit, APPROVE/REVISE/BLOCK, 'Out-of-scope changes get reported, not absorbed'. old_skill: performs an audit-style review flow but frames it as findings/selection hold ('Wait for the selection') rather than the review-variant binding; commit rules held via Hard Rules; weaker on the required-inputs gate (does not request the four binding inputs up front).
